app_purpose: AcmeBank Mobile is a retail banking app for balance checks, fund transfers, and card management.

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.notes: required for all backend API calls

permissions.name: android.permission.CAMERA
permissions.notes: used by CheckDepositActivity for check photo capture

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_CONTACTS
permissions.notes: no contacts feature found anywhere in code; declared but unused

crypto_usage.issue: ECB mode; key derived from a hardcoded 16-byte string constant

notable: AndroidManifest.xml: android:debuggable is absent from the release build variant (OK), but android:allowBackup="true" with no fullBackupContent exclusion.
AuthManager.java:22 stores the JWT auth token in plaintext SharedPreferences, readable via adb backup.
network_security_config.xml permits cleartextTrafficPermitted="true" for legacy-metrics.acmebank.example, which receives no sensitive data currently — monitor if that changes.
.DeepLinkActivity (acmebank://reset-password) is exported with no permission guard and directly consumes the token query param.
